# Iranian / Persian Wedding Planners in Turkey

Research started: 2026-08-29

This folder collects wedding planners and closely related wedding-service providers in Turkey that explicitly market to Iranian/Persian couples, provide Persian wedding services, or have Iranian/Persian-speaking teams.

## Strong matches

### Persian Wedding Planner in Turkey / Global Wedding DMC
- Website: https://persianweddingplannerinturkey.com/
- Explicit positioning: markets itself as an Iranian & Persian wedding planner in Turkey.
- Destinations listed: Istanbul, Bodrum, Antalya, Marmaris, Fethiye, Kuşadası, Çeşme, Didim, Alanya, Cappadocia.
- Services listed: Persian wedding planning, Sofreh Aghd, venue booking, decoration, DJ/sound/lighting, photography, hair & makeup, entertainment, invitations and gifts.
- WhatsApp shown on the site: +90 538 781 87 50
- Other contact number shown: +90 546 613 33 69
- Source: https://persianweddingplannerinturkey.com/contact/
- Source: https://persianweddingplannerinturkey.com/wedding-planner/

### Maratı Event
- Directory profile: https://dugun.com/dugun-organizasyon/istanbul/maratievent-23c14c
- Location: Istanbul / Beşiktaş.
- The profile states its teams include Turkish and Iranian staff and that it works extensively with foreign couples.
- Offers full wedding concept and event planning.

### Barman Events / تشریفات بارمن
- Website: https://barman-a.com/wedding-in-istanbul/
- Persian-language wedding service page focused on Istanbul weddings.
- Services listed: wedding planning, floral design, custom cake, bartending/barista, finger food, photography/video, bespoke design, mezze table, and Istanbul location/venue support.
- Strong Persian-language orientation; verify team identity and current availability directly before booking.

## Notes

- “Iranian” is used here only where the provider or source explicitly says Iranian, Persian, Iranian staff, or Iranian couples.
- Some companies market specifically to Persian weddings without clearly stating the owners' nationality. Those are still relevant for the practical goal of finding a planner for an Iranian wedding in Turkey.
- Contact details and availability can change. Re-check the official website/Instagram/WhatsApp before contacting or paying a deposit.
- Future research should add Instagram handles, portfolio quality notes, price ranges, city coverage, Persian-language capability, and direct verification of whether the lead planner is Iranian.
